record.paper_title: Traces on Operator Ideals Defined over the Class of all Banach Spaces and Related Open Problems
record.original_question: For 1 <= r <= 2, let P_{r,2} denote the ideal of (r,2)-summing operators. Theorem 2.4 constructs traces on (P_{r,2})^{APP}_{r,\infty} from 2^{-1/r}S_+-invariant linear forms on d_{r,\infty}(N0). Show that (P_{r,2})^{APP}_{r,\infty} has no traces other than those constructed in Theorem 2.4.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Setup. For $1\le r\le 2$, an operator $T:X\to Y$ between Banach spaces is called $(r,2)$-summing if there exists a constant $c\ge 0$ such that for every finite family $x_1,\dots,x_n\in X$,
$$\Bigl(\sum_{k=1}^n \|Tx_k\|^r\Bigr)^{1/r}\le c\,\sup_{\|x^*\|\le 1}\Bigl(\sum_{k=1}^n |\langle x_k,x^*\rangle|^2\Bigr)^{1/2}.$$
The class of all such operators forms a Banach operator ideal $\mathfrak P_{r,2}$.

Let $\mathfrak P_{r,2}^{\mathrm{APP}}$ denote the approximative kernel of $\mathfrak P_{r,2}$, i.e. the closure of the ideal of finite-rank operators in the $(r,2)$-summing norm. For a Banach operator ideal $\mathfrak A$ and exponents $0<p\le\infty$, the Lorentz-type enlargement $\mathfrak A_{r,\infty}$ consists of operators $T$ whose approximation numbers $a_n(T)$ satisfy $\sup_{n\ge 1} n^{1/r} a_n(T)<\infty$, suitably combined with $\mathfrak A$. Consider the ideal
$$(\mathfrak P_{r,2})^{\mathrm{APP}}_{r,\infty}.$$

A trace on an operator ideal $\mathfrak I$ is a linear functional $\tau:\mathfrak I(\ell_2)\to\mathbb C$ (or on the components on each Banach space, compatibly) that is unitarily invariant and satisfies $\tau(AB)=\tau(BA)$ whenever both products lie in $\mathfrak I$.

On the sequence space
$$d_{r,\infty}(\mathbb N_0)=\Bigl\{(\xi_k)_{k\ge 0}: \sup_{n\ge 1} n^{1/r}\xi_n^*<\infty\Bigr\},$$
(with $(\xi_n^*)$ the decreasing rearrangement) let $S_+$ denote the dyadic-block shift, and consider linear forms on $d_{r,\infty}(\mathbb N_0)$ that are invariant under $2^{-1/r}S_+$. There is a known construction producing traces on $(\mathfrak P_{r,2})^{\mathrm{APP}}_{r,\infty}$ from such $2^{-1/r}S_+$-invariant linear forms.

Problem. Prove that every trace on the operator ideal $(\mathfrak P_{r,2})^{\mathrm{APP}}_{r,\infty}$ arises from this construction; equivalently, show that no traces exist on $(\mathfrak P_{r,2})^{\mathrm{APP}}_{r,\infty}$ other than those produced from $2^{-1/r}S_+$-invariant linear forms on $d_{r,\infty}(\mathbb N_0)$.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem appears as one of a collection of open problems posed in Pietsch's 2023 survey on traces on operator ideals over the class of all Banach spaces. No subsequent resolution is indicated in available search results; related work on traces and singular traces on operator ideals continues, but this specific classification problem for $(\mathfrak P_{r,2})^{\mathrm{APP}}_{r,\infty}$ does not appear to have been settled.
